entries.title: US-only PHI storage and access
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must access, store, and process PHI solely within the Covered Entity Environment in the US, using only identified US-based personnel.
entries.quote: Business Associate shall access, store and process PHI only within the Covered Entity Environment, and only through personnel of Business Associate who are located in the United States and who have been identified to Covered Entity by name in writing.

relatedClauses.quote: No PHI shall be accessed, stored or processed outside the United States.

entries.endRule: Continues until the Master Services Agreement expires or is terminated.
entries.notes: Tied to the term of the Master Services Agreement, which is not provided.

entries.title: 5-day Breach Notification
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc must report any unauthorized use/disclosure of PHI or Breach of Unsecured PHI to CareBridge within 5 business days of discovery.
entries.quote: Business Associate shall report to Covered Entity any use or disclosure of PHI not provided for by this BAA, including any Breach of Unsecured PHI, without unreasonable delay and in no case later than five (5) business days after discovery.
entries.endRule: Continues until the Master Services Agreement expires or is terminated.
entries.notes: Standard HIPAA BAA notification window, but capped at 5 business days.

entries.title: Annual HIPAA Compliance Assessment
entries.summary: Upon 30 days' written notice, CareBridge may request documentation once every 12 months (or more frequently following a Breach) to verify compliance.
entries.quote: Upon thirty (30) days' written notice, and not more than once in any twelve (12) month period unless following a Breach, Covered Entity may request reasonable documentation (including a completed security questionnaire and relevant policies) to verify Business Associate's compliance with this BAA.
entries.endRule: Continues until the Master Services Agreement expires or is terminated.
entries.notes: Allows CareBridge to audit security compliance annually via questionnaire and policies.

entries.title: De-identified data restricted use
entries.summary: AtliQ Inc is restricted from using de-identified patient data for any client, product, or purpose other than performing the patient-scheduling analytics services.
entries.quote: De-identified Data may be used only for the Services and not for any other client, product or purpose.

relatedClauses.quote: De-identified Data means health information that has been de-identified in accordance with 45 C.F.R. § 164.514(b) and that is therefore not PHI.

entries.endRule: Continues until the Master Services Agreement expires or is terminated.
entries.notes: Limits AtliQ's ability to use de-identified data for product improvement or other client projects.

referencedButMissing.name: Master Services Agreement
referencedButMissing.note: Mentioned in Recital A and Section 10.1 as the agreement that determines the term and details of the patient-scheduling analytics services.
